verified_facts.text: The hotel is set on 35 waterfront acres near Tampa International Airport, with wildlife views and two pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set on 35 waterfront acres near Tampa International Airport, the hotel offers a peaceful retreat with wildlife views and two pools.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's 35-acre nature preserve is the backdrop to its pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel’s 35-acre nature preserve provides an ideal background for guests to relax, refresh and recharge.

verified_facts.text: Guests can take in sunset views along the hotel's dock and at its firepits.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take in the sunset views along our dock and at our firepits.

verified_facts.text: Guests can ride a bicycle on a 9.5-mile scenic trail or walk the nature trail on the 35-acre property.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a bicycle ride on the 9.5-mile scenic trail or a walk along the nature trail on our 35-acre property.

verified_facts.text: Sports on the property include tennis and pickleball.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a variety of offerings and sports right here on our property, including tennis and pickleball.

verified_facts.text: The hotel connects to several hiking and biking trails that run along the water's edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel also connects to several hiking and biking trails that run along the water’s edge.

verified_facts.text: The Rooftop Sunset Experience takes place on the 14th-floor Skylark Terrace, with firepits, plush seating and views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience sunsets from the 14th-floor Skylark Terrace at Grand Hyatt Tampa Bay. Enjoy firepits, plush seating and stunning views

verified_facts.text: Guests can rent a private daybed by the waterfront with poolside service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind in style with a private daybed by the waterfront at Grand Hyatt Tampa Bay. Enjoy poolside service, bottled water, seasonal fruit cups and a cooler with ice.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are coastal-inspired, and many have water or city views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Retreat to our waterfront hotel’s newly renovated, coastal-inspired rooms, many with water or city views.

verified_facts.text: The casitas are villa-style rooms a five-minute walk from the main tower, near the bayside pool and Oystercatchers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The room is a scenic five-minute walk from the main tower and is near the bayside pool and Oystercatchers Restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Some rooms offer views of the Tampa International Airport runways.
verified_facts.excerpt: striking Tampa International Airport runway views

verified_facts.text: The Bay View Suite offers views of the bay and is on floors 10 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy spectacular views of the bay from our 750-square-foot suite located on floors 10–12

verified_facts.text: The Casita Suite is a two-story, loft-style villa with a full bathroom on each floor and a patio.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spread out in our 750-square-foot two-story, loft-style villa with a king bed and full bathroom upstairs and downstairs, a sleeper sofa, a half bath, a patio

verified_facts.text: The Grand Residence is a two-story loft-style villa with a full kitchen and a large patio.
verified_facts.excerpt: Live like a local in this 1,100-square-foot two-story loft-style villa with a king bed and full bathroom upstairs and a full kitchen, separate dining space, a sleeper sofa, a large patio

verified_facts.text: Oystercatchers overlooks Tampa Bay and serves fresh, local seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: Overlooking beautiful Tampa Bay, Oystercatchers offers fresh, local seafood with stunning views and a serene atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: 1823 Kitchen & Bar is on the lobby level and is named for the year Tampa was settled.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1823 Kitchen & Bar, located on the hotel lobby level and named for the year Tampa was settled, serves locally inspired dishes

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly, with dog-friendly rooms in the casitas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Tampa Bay is a pet-friendly hotel, with dog-friendly rooms in our casitas.
